message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is an extreme detailed breakdown of the **OmniRoute** dashboard UI design:

### 1. Overall Layout
The interface follows a classic **SaaS dashboard layout** with a fixed sidebar on the left and a scrollable main content area on the right.
*   **Sidebar (Left):** Fixed width (approx. 240px), light gray background, containing navigation and user profile.
*   **Header (Top of Main Area):** Contains the page title, environment status, global filters, and utility icons.
*   **Main Content Grid:** Organized into three distinct horizontal bands:
    1.  **KPI Cards Row:** Five metric cards spanning the full width.
    2.  **Workflow/Process Bar:** A horizontal stepper showing the routing logic.
    3.  **Data Panels Row:** A split view with a wide "Live requests" table (left, approx. 65% width) and a narrower "Providers" list (right, approx. 35% width).

### 2. Color Scheme & Visual Style
*   **Theme:** **Light Mode / Clean SaaS**. The background is a very soft, cool gray (`#F9FAFB` or similar).
*   **Primary Brand Color:** A vibrant **Royal Blue** (`#3B82F6`) used for the logo icon, active nav states, and primary links.
*   **Semantic Colors:**
    *   **Success/Green:** Used for "Live" indicators, positive metrics ("saved 100%", "online" status), and the "Free/Routing Here" step.
    *   **Warning/Amber:** Used for "Auto-failovers" metric and "failing over" or "failover" status tags.
    *   **Purple:** Used specifically for the "Tokens saved" metric to make it pop.
    *   **Text:** Dark Slate Gray (`#111827`) for headings, lighter gray (`#6B7280`) for secondary text/labels.
*   **Visual Effects:**
    *   **Soft Shadows:** Cards have very subtle, diffuse drop shadows (no hard borders).
    *   **Rounded Corners:** Heavy use of `border-radius` (approx. 8px-12px) on cards, buttons, and avatars.
    *   **Glassmorphism/Transparency:** Minimal, but the "Free" badges have a slight translucent green background look.

### 3. Component Inventory

#### **A. Sidebar Components**
*   **Logo Area:**
    *   Icon: Rounded square with a white sparkle/star symbol on blue gradient background.
    *   Text: "**OmniRoute**" in bold, dark sans-serif.
*   **Navigation Menu:**
    *   **Active Item:** "Overview" (Icon: Grid layout). Background is light blue-gray; text is blue.
    *   **Inactive Items:**
        *   "Requests" (Icon: Activity pulse). Has a small green badge saying "**LIVE**".
        *   "Providers" (Icon: List/Stack).
        *   "Routing" (Icon: Arrows branching).
        *   "Compression" (Icon: Compress arrows).
    *   **Section Header:** "ACCOUNT" (small, uppercase, tracked-out spacing).
    *   **Account Links:**
        *   "API Keys" (Icon: Key).
        *   "Usage" (Icon: Bar chart).
        *   "Settings" (Icon: Slider/Gear).
*   **User Profile (Bottom):**
    *   Avatar: Purple square with white letter "**F**".
    *   Name: "**Farea**".
    *   Handle: "@fareanfts".
    *   Badge: Green pill "**Free tier**".

#### **B. Header Components**
*   **Title Section:**
    *   Heading: "**Overview**" (Large, bold).
    *   Status Badge: Green dot + "**Production**".
*   **Controls (Right Aligned):**
    *   Status: Green dot + "**routing live**".
    *   Dropdown: "**Last 24 hours**" (with chevron down).
    *   Metric Pill: "**237 providers**".
    *   Icon Button: Bell/Notification icon.

#### **C. KPI Cards (Top Row)**
Five distinct cards with white backgrounds:
1.  **Requests routed:**
    *   Value: **51,904** (Large bold black).
    *   Chart: Green sparkline trending up.
    *   Subtext: Green up-arrow + "**13.6% vs yesterday**".
2.  **Tokens saved:**
    *   Value: **43.2M** (Purple text).
    *   Chart: Purple wavy line.
    *   Subtext: "**RTK + Caveman** up to **95% off**" (RTK and Caveman are purple links).
3.  **Free providers:**
    *   Value: **90 / 237** (Black/Light gray).
    *   Subtext: Green dot + "**all online**, $0 spent".
4.  **Auto-failovers:**
    *   Value: **1,381** (Amber/Orange text).
    *   Subtext: "**0 dropped**, avg 0ms switch".
5.  **Spend today:**
    *   Value: **$0.00** (Green text).
    *   Subtext: "**saved 100%** vs $512 est." (Green text).

#### **D. Workflow / Routing Logic Bar**
A horizontal process flow labeled "**Auto-fallback**" with subtitle "4-tier routing":
*   **Step 1 (Subscription):** Label "**Claude Max, GPT Pro**". Grey progress bar underneath.
*   **Arrow:** Right pointing chevron.
*   **Step 2 (API Key):** Label "**your paid keys**". Grey progress bar.
*   **Arrow:** Right pointing chevron.
*   **Step 3 (Cheap):** Label "**DeepSeek, GLM**". Grey progress bar.
*   **Arrow:** Right pointing chevron.
*   **Step 4 (Free - Active):**
    *   Badges: Number "4" in circle, "**FREE**" (green), "**ROUTING HERE**" (dark green).
    *   Label: "**Groq, Cerebras, Gemini**".
    *   Progress Bar: **Solid Green** (indicating active).
*   **Side Note:** Link text "**17 routing strategies**" and label "**cheapest active**".

#### **E. Live Requests Table (Main Panel)**
*   **Header:**
    *   Title: "**Live requests**".
    *   Subtitle: "*streaming from 5 agents*" (italics).
    *   Indicator: Green dot + "**real-time**".
*   **Columns:** TIME | AGENT | MODEL | PROVIDER | TOKENS | LATENCY | STATUS.
*   **Rows (Data):**
    1.  `19:41:12` | Claude Code (icon) | `claude-sonnet-4.5` | Anthropic (icon) | 1,284 | 0.41s | **200 OK** (green)
    2.  `19:41:09` | Cursor (icon) | `gpt-5.5` | OpenAI (icon) | 3,912 | 0.88s | **200 OK** (green)
    3.  `19:41:07` | Cline (icon) | `gemini-2.5-flash` | Google (icon) + **FREE** badge | 842 | 0.29s | **200 OK** (green)
    4.  `19:41:05` | Codex (icon) | `llama-3.3-70b` | Cerebras (icon) -> **Groq** (orange arrow/text) | 2,150 | 0.24s | **failover** (amber bg)
    5.  `19:41:02` | Copilot (icon) | `deepseek-v4` | DeepSeek (icon) | 2,061 | 1.02s | **200 OK** (green)
    6.  `19:40:58` | Claude Code (icon) | `glm-5.2` | Zhipu GLM (icon) + **FREE** badge | 1,342 | 0.61s | **200 OK** (green)

#### **F. Providers List (Right Panel)**
*   **Header:** "**Providers**" | Count "**90 FREE**" (green).
*   **List Items (Vertical):**
    1.  **Anthropic:** `claude-sonnet-4.5` | Latency: `312ms` | Status: **online** (green dot).
    2.  **Cerebras:** `llama-3.3-70b, fastest` | **FREE** badge | Latency: `rate-limit` | Status: **failing over** (orange dot).
    3.  **Groq:** `llama-3.3-70b, 92ms` | **FREE** badge | Latency: `92ms` | Status: **online** (green dot).
    4.  **Google:** `gemini-2.5-flash` | **FREE** badge | Latency: `201ms` | Status: **online** (green dot).
    5.  **DeepSeek:** `deepseek-v4` | Latency: `640ms` | Status: **online** (green dot).
    6.  **OpenAI:** `gpt-5.5` | Latency: `488ms` | Status: **online** (green dot).
*   **Footer Link:** "**+ 84 more free providers**" (blue) / "237 total connected" (gray).

### 4. Typography & Spacing
*   **Font Family:** Likely **Inter** or a similar geometric sans-serif (e.g., SF Pro Display). It features high legibility and varied weights.
*   **Hierarchy:**
    *   **H1 (Page Title):** ~24px, Bold.
    *   **Card Metrics:** ~32px, Bold/Tabular nums (monospaced numbers for alignment).
    *   **Body Text:** ~14px, Regular.
    *   **Captions/Meta:** ~12px, Medium weight, often uppercased or colored gray.
*   **Spacing:** Generous whitespace. Padding inside cards is approx 20px-24px. Gap between grid items is approx 16px-20px.

### 5. Navigation Structure
The navigation is **icon + label** based.
*   **Primary Nav:** Overview, Requests, Providers, Routing, Compression.
*   **Secondary Nav (Account):** API Keys, Usage, Settings.
*   **Contextual Navigation:** The "Auto-fallback" bar acts as a visual navigator for the current routing logic state.

### 6. Icons, Logos & Branding
*   **Brand Logo:** Abstract "sparkle" or "star" inside a rounded rect.
*   **Provider Icons:** Each AI provider has a distinct, colorful rounded-square icon:
    *   Anthropic: Orange/Red warm glow.
    *   OpenAI: Black/White spiral knot.
    *   Google: Multicolor star/diamond (Gemini style).
    *   Cerebras: Orange swirl.
    *   Groq: Red/Orange 'G' shape.
    *   DeepSeek: Blue whale/kite shape.
    *   Zhipu GLM: Blue abstract pattern.
*   **Agent Icons:** Specific app icons for IDE tools (Cursor, VS Code/Cline, etc.).

### 7. Data Visualizations
*   **Sparklines:** Mini line charts inside KPI cards (Green for volume, Purple for tokens).
*   **Progress Bars:** Horizontal bars under the routing steps to indicate capacity or current selection (solid green for active).
*   **Status Pills:** Rounded rectangular badges for status codes (200 OK = green bg/green text; failover = amber bg/amber text).
*   **Real-time Indicators:** Pulsing green dots to indicate live streaming data.

### 8. Look & Feel Summary
*   **Theme:** **Light Mode, Clean, High-Fidelity SaaS.**
*   **Vibe:** It feels like a **modern developer tool** or **FinTech infrastructure dashboard**. It is dense with information but remains readable through strict alignment and color coding.
*   **Style:** **"Corporate Memphis" meets "Developer Utility"**. It uses friendly rounded corners but presents serious, real-time data. No glassmorphism or heavy gradients—mostly flat colors with subtle shadows.

### 9. Every Visible Label & Data Point
(See Section 3 for the exhaustive list of text visible, including specific model names like `gpt-5.5`, latency values like `0.29s`, and counts like `237 providers`.)

### 10. Design Language
*   **Domain:** **AI Infrastructure / LLM Gateway / Model Routing**.
*   **Language:** **"Developer-First Enterprise"**. It balances technical depth (showing specific model versions and latencies) with business metrics (cost savings, uptime). It resembles dashboards found in platforms like Vercel, Stripe, or specialized AI proxy services (like OpenRouter or Portkey). The use of terms like "Routing," "Failover," "Tokens," and "Providers" confirms this is a control plane for managing Large Language Model traffic.
